snippet.title: Snow That Hums Trailer
snippet.description:
A Short Sci-Fi Pixel Visual Novel
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4643950/Snow_That_Hums/ 
In a snow-covered industrial city, a man walks through empty streets filled with noise. He listens more than he looks. When a young woman interrupts his routine, the world begins to shift.
